annotations.target_phrase: Garvey captive. Yacht, came before, she came back. Now she lockin’ steady on Marcus Garvey.
annotations.annotation_text: Tessier-Ashpool corporate security seizing the Marcus Garvey tugboat, intensifying the spatial trap around Case and Maelcum as they prepare the final cyberdeck run.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 178.
